notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing or incorrect in the Mozio email confirmation specifically for return-trip tickets. The return-trip mapping path in create-reservations.mappers.ts swaps from/to stations but likely does not propagate or correctly calculate the discount/report price for the return dispatch. The apply-report-discounts.service.ts and map-line-item-return-trip-modification.ts are also in the data path that feeds the sanitized dispatch shown in the Mozio confirmation email.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria, so all criteria above are new. I built them from the story context: the defect is that promo code discount amounts are missing or incorrect specifically for return-trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The key risk area is the return-trip mapping path (station swap in create-reservations.mappers.ts) which may not propagate discount data through apply-report-discounts.service.ts and map-line-item-return-trip-modification.ts into map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts. AC-1 and AC-2 cover monetary and percentage discounts respectively. AC-3 targets the station-swap data-loss hypothesis. AC-4 and AC-5 guard against regressions on one-way and no-promo scenarios. AC-6 covers the edge case of over-discount (negative totals). AC-7 ensures the discount propagates through the full data path to the sanitized dispatch. AC-8 covers the zero-discount edge case to prevent null/undefined field rendering.
